description:
First consumer device hulls terminals ship: taste actuators input plus device logistics output in one wearable.

title: Taste Interface Devices Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Taste Interface Devices operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Taste Interface Devices installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 54744 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where taste actuators monitoring, device logistics redundancy, or flavor models maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Taste Interface Devices Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Taste Interface Devices: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Taste Interface Devices — devices reproducing tastes remotely.

Phase 1 — Prove (taste actuators): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (device logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (flavor models): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (hygiene design): device hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and food-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
